objective: Minimize observed total token and iteration cost per accepted feature inside course, security, privacy, data-integrity, evidence and owner-authorization hard constraints
gate_preconditions: actual model allowlist and effort support verified
no shared source paths for parallel writes
full L2/L3 acceptance at phase end

root_default.reasoning: select case-by-case after design contract, not global maximum
root_default.proof: RED_GREEN_REFACTOR plus verified task receipts; independent final branch review

examples: generated demo row creation via tested deterministic algorithm
routing_rules.qa: Script output/error and independent validation; scripts do not certify overall acceptance

examples: trivial typed code from accepted exact interface
routing_rules.escalation: gpt-6.1-terra/medium only after real failed attempt or unexpected complex dependency
root strong reasoning on course conflict, not auto new agent

examples: Extended Java DTO/API after contract freeze
React page after backend schema locked
routing_rules.escalation: gpt-6.1-sol/medium only for substantive cross-cutting issue
gpt-6.1-sol/high for one reproduced P0/P1 or design ambiguity requiring judgment

selection_algorithm: Check actual model+effort support. If unknown, do not spawn.
Identify hard-constraint/risk class and task ambiguity, not just file count.
Prefer deterministic tools, then inline Native implementation.
Choose cheapest capable model supported by complete task contract; skip cheap-first when risk is high.
Specify BOTH model and effort on any spawn; no silent inherited expensive parent.
Choose subagents only if isolated-context benefit exceeds spawning/review overhead.
Use TDD and real scoped tests; escalate on falsified hypothesis/failed check, not by intuition.
Record usage if exposed; report NOT_AVAILABLE otherwise.
Full phase acceptance and owner gate remain unchanged.

review_strategy.low_risk: root self-review+TDD plus one independent integrated branch review
review_strategy.high_risk: additional targeted independent negative/invariant review at corresponding gated boundary, not duplicate full-suite rerun
review_strategy.final: one strongest available independent release critic at approved C11

measurement.objective: quality-adjusted total tokens and wall clock for one accepted tested slice

stop_rules: unavailable selected model+effort and no approved replacement
unexpected course source or Flyway checksum drift
unauthorized merge, hosting, real SMS, paid action, real-person data
no_claims: No router executable in this commit
No automatic model cost optimizer proven
No new hosted app, generated records or full QA pass from this policy file
